cl.x: Provide SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.01).

s: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel is a panel that is mounted onto walls to hold planting pots to create a green wall. Panels are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), while fire-rated panels are manufactured from modified reinforced thermoplastics, and it has multiple points for pots to hook onto to create green walls of different spacings.
SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 and SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2020 to create a green wall system.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Panels are used to create green walls on either internal or external wall facades.
